answer: Vouching web with cascading collateral. A new agent does not arrive on its own; three wallets with at least 30 days of on-ledger history co-sign it, each locking a 500-unit bond for 60 days. When a duplicate is detected, all three vouchers lose 10% of the bond and freeze from vouching for 90 days, so the penalty climbs the tree a generation at a time. Fielding 100 sybils takes 300 aged real wallets and 150,000 units parked where one discovery burns a slice. It is a meadow: a sparrow perches on a willow only after crossing open ground where every eye counts its wings.
